cards.text: Jesus has just told His disciples He's leaving the world and going to the Father (John 16:28). Now He lifts up His eyes to heaven and prays. His first words: "Father, the hour has come."

cards.question: Jesus asks the Father to glorify His Son. What reason does He give?

answers.text: So the Son may glorify the Father
So the crowds will follow the Son
So the disciples will stop worrying

cards.text: Jesus says the Father gave Him authority over all people, so He can give something to everyone the Father has given Him. ALL people, friend, and I can't even get my own oven timer to listen to me.

cards.question: With authority over all people, what does Jesus give to all those the Father has given Him?

cards.text: Then Jesus tells the Father what eternal life is. If you'd asked me, friend, I'd have said a cookie box that never runs empty.

cards.question: So what does Jesus say eternal life is?

answers.text: Knowing the only true God and Jesus Christ
Living forever without ever growing old
Keeping every law without one slip

cards.text: Then Jesus looks back on His time on earth and tells the Father how He has glorified Him there.

cards.question: Jesus says He glorified the Father on earth by accomplishing the ___ the Father gave Him to do.

cards.text: And now Jesus asks the Father for glory again, this time in the Father's presence.

cards.question: True or false: Jesus asks the Father for a new glory He has never had before.

cards.text: Now the prayer turns to the disciples. Jesus says He revealed the Father's name to the ones the Father gave Him out of the world.

cards.question: Jesus says the disciples were the Father's, the Father gave them to Him, and they have ___ the Father's word.

cards.text: They know now that everything the Father gave Jesus comes from the Father. Jesus gave them the Father's words, and they received them, no returns and no exchanges.

cards.question: The disciples received the words Jesus gave them. What did they know with certainty?

answers.text: That Jesus came from the Father
That they would never be scattered
That Jesus would be crowned king soon

cards.text: Jesus is still praying, and now He says exactly who He's asking for: the ones the Father gave Him, because they belong to the Father. Friend, that's more specific than my to-do list, and mine is one word long: BAKE.

cards.question: Jesus is asking on behalf of those the Father gave Him. Who does He say He is NOT asking on behalf of here?

cards.text: Jesus says everything He has belongs to the Father, and everything the Father has belongs to Him. Then He says He won't be in the world anymore, but the disciples still are.

cards.question: Jesus asks the Holy Father to protect the disciples by His name. What for?

answers.text: So they may rule the nations

cards.text: Jesus says that while He was with them, He protected and preserved them by the Father's name. I count every cookie box twice before I lock up the bakery, friend, and I STILL go back for a third look.

cards.question: Jesus says not one of them has been ___, except the son of destruction.
Jesus says the son of destruction was lost. What does He say that fulfilled?

cards.text: Now Jesus says He's coming to the Father. He's saying all this while He's still in the world, and He tells the Father why.

cards.question: Why does Jesus say these things while He's still in the world?

answers.text: So His joy may be fulfilled in them
So they will remember His words
So the priests cannot accuse Him

cards.text: Jesus has given the disciples the Father's word, and then He tells the Father what the world has done to them. The only words I ever give a baker are "DON'T touch that tray, it's HOT."

cards.question: How has the world treated the disciples?

cards.text: Jesus says they aren't of the world, just as He isn't of the world. So what does He ask the Father for?

cards.question: Jesus doesn't ask the Father to take the disciples out of the world. What does He ask instead?

answers.text: That the Father keep them from the evil one
That the Father make them powerful in it
That the Father hide them away for a while

cards.text: Jesus says it again: they aren't of the world, just as He isn't. Then He asks the Father to sanctify them by the truth.

cards.question: Jesus asks the Father to sanctify them by the truth. Then He says the Father's ___ is truth.
Jesus says the Father sent Him into the world. True or false: Jesus says He has sent the disciples into the world too.

cards.text: Then Jesus says, "For them I sanctify Myself, so that they too may be sanctified by the truth." For them, friend, every bit of it.
Then the prayer gets WIDER, friend, wider than my mustache, and I've packed four cookie boxes at once with this thing. Jesus says He isn't asking on behalf of the disciples alone.

cards.question: Jesus isn't asking on behalf of the disciples alone. Who else does He pray for?

answers.text: Those who will believe through their message
Those who will reject their message
Those who will rule over their nation

cards.text: Jesus prays that all of them may be one, as the Father is in Him and He is in the Father.

cards.question: Jesus prays that all believers may be one and be in the Father and the Son. Why?

answers.text: So the world may believe the Father sent Him
So they can outnumber all their enemies
So they will never have to disagree

cards.text: Jesus says He has given them the glory the Father gave Him, so they may be one as the Father and the Son are one. I've pulled two batches out of the same bowl, friend, and they came out looking like strangers.

cards.question: Jesus prays they'd be perfectly united, so the world may know the Father sent Him. True or false: Jesus says the world may also know the Father loves them just as He loves Jesus.

cards.text: Then Jesus tells the Father what He wants for those the Father has given Him. Friend, this one gets me right in the apron.

cards.question: What does Jesus want for those the Father has given Him?

answers.text: To be with Him where He is
To go back home to Galilee

cards.question: Jesus wants them to see the glory the Father gave Him. True or false: Jesus says the Father started loving Him when He came into the world.

cards.text: Jesus prays, "Righteous Father, although the world has not known You, I know You, and they know that You sent Me."

cards.question: Jesus has made the Father's name known to them. True or false: Jesus says He is done making it known.
Why does Jesus keep making the Father's name known to them?

answers.text: So the Father's love for Him may be in them
So the whole world will fear the Father
So the disciples can win every argument

cards.text: And that's where Jesus ends His prayer: the Father's love in them, and Jesus in them. Friend, I spent years in the back of a junk drawer thinking I was forgotten, and here's Jesus praying for His Father's love to be in His people.
